title: fix(ui): plugin sidebar selection falls out of sync when navigating
body:
Closes #157699
Closes #156319

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes missing or stale selected styling on plugin-contributed sidebar pages when navigating between pages, using browser history, or adding page filters.

## User Impact

Plugin pages such as Workboard now show the same active icon and full-width selected row as built-in pages, and lose that highlight when you leave them.

## Why This Change Was Made

Native plugin navigation did not subscribe to route changes and compared the entire URL string. It now uses the existing lifecycle-managed router subscription and matches the destination's path and explicit parameters, while allowing unrelated page filters. The shared sidebar sizing rule also reaches the link inside the plugin's layout-transparent wrapper.

## Evidence

Live before/after on an isolated Gateway with the bundled Workboard plugin, at 1440×900 and 390×844. Before: Workboard remains highlighted after opening Automations, and its row is too narrow. After: only the current page is highlighted, and Workboard fills the same row width as built-in pages. No browser errors in either run.

![Live desktop and mobile before/after](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/370200d5-871d-47a3-80ea-5177e235a593)

- Reproduced both stale selection and narrow row failures before changing production code.
- Browser regression and native plugin lifecycle suites: **8 passed**, including admin/read-only navigation, back/forward, reordered queries, extra filters, row width, reload, and existing plugin lifecycle coverage.
- Sidebar and plugin contribution unit suites: **162 passed**.
- Full `pnpm build` and the repository changed-file checks passed, including type checks, lint, formatting, i18n, and unused-export scans. Independent AutoReview found no P0 blockers.

<details>
<summary>Validation and review context</summary>

Baseline: `0484d7a3ecf52589b0d3d98741e58e5f6b5bf661`. The screenshots compare baseline and candidate UI builds against the same isolated real Gateway and Workboard plugin. The regression suite uses the existing mock Gateway browser harness to keep route invalidation independent of Workboard data refreshes.

```sh
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner ui/src/e2e/native-plugin-navigation.e2e.test.ts ui/src/e2e/native-plugin-ui.e2e.test.ts
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/plugins/control-ui-contributions.test.ts ui/src/components/app-sidebar.sessions.test.ts
pnpm build
node scripts/check-changed.mjs -- ui/src/plugins/control-ui-view.runtime.ts ui/src/e2e/native-plugin-ui.e2e.test.ts ui/src/e2e/native-plugin-navigation.e2e.test.ts ui/src/styles/sidebar-reorder.css
```

The change replaces exact URL equality and extends the existing subscription and CSS owners; it introduces no alternative navigation flow. Production delta: +10 net lines (router lifecycle subscription, URL parameter contract, and one shared CSS selector). Tests: +41 net lines, with the existing navigation/reload scenario moved into a focused sibling file to respect the file-size limit. No configuration or persistence changes.

Observed follow-up outside this fix: selecting a native plugin link in the mobile drawer leaves the drawer open, unlike built-in links. This existed in both baseline and candidate; drawer dismissal should be handled separately.

<!-- plugin-sidebar-test-cost:start -->
Test cost: `native-plugin-navigation.e2e.test.ts` passed with `--maxWorkers 1`: **14.07 s process wall time**, **12.68 s Vitest duration** including setup, and **3.189 s test-file execution** for two cases. On [hosted CI, shard 7/9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36074328133/job/107941484940), the file passed in **4.977 s** (admin 2.762 s, read-only 2.017 s). The shared 79-file shard passed in 512.74 s of Vitest time / 604 s total job time; those shared totals are not this file's incremental cost. This file moves and extends the existing admin/read-only scenario rather than adding another copy. Browser-level proof is needed for route invalidation and actual rendered row width, which lower-level registry tests do not exercise.
<!-- plugin-sidebar-test-cost:end -->

</details>

<!-- plugin-sidebar-ci-repair:start -->
CI follow-up: the original run failed only the Guest question lifecycle test because its fixture constructed admitted authority without the live role reader. Rebased onto the existing main repair [229ab8a1fe9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/229ab8a1fe957d3d4822309a39ddf9c7ec616395), which uses the Gateway authority capture owner. `git range-diff` confirms the sidebar patch is unchanged. The guest question, plugin navigation, and native plugin lifecycle suites pass together (9 tests). New-head CI will rerun the affected shard in its normal order.
<!-- plugin-sidebar-ci-repair:end -->
